headlineMentions.title: Closing In
headlineMentions.narrative: Sven Almqvist cut Maxime Lefort's championship lead from 29 points to 3.

headlineMentions.title: Photo Finish
headlineMentions.narrative: Sven Almqvist edged Jakub Novotny at the line by 0.445 seconds.

headlineMentions.title: Hard Charger
headlineMentions.narrative: Tyler Hargrove climbed from P9 to P2, the biggest gain in class.

headlineMentions.title: Photo Finish
headlineMentions.narrative: Piotr Zielinski edged Viktor Halvorsen at the line by 0.064 seconds.

headlineMentions.title: Bounce Back
headlineMentions.narrative: Declan Rourke rebounded from P13 last round to P2 this round.

headlineMentions.title: Streak Watch
headlineMentions.narrative: Ines Carvalho extended their podium streak to 5 rounds.
